annotations.text:
Dashboard, three directions.

What I was fixing, from the screenshots:

1. The Current Courses card is very tall and holds one line of italic text, so the page reads as broken rather than empty.
2. Everything below the cards is dead space.
3. Two layers of chrome before any content: the teal bar sits directly under a sidebar that is already branded.
4. "No courses found." and "None" state a fact but offer no way forward.
5. The eight-box registration code field is a lot of visual noise for one short code.

All three use the app's real tokens, so what differs is structure, not palette.

A · Quiet chrome

The smallest change that fixes the most. The teal bar becomes a 3px accent rule on a white header, cards hug their content, and the empty state grows into a real one with two clear actions.

For: recognisably the same app, so it is the cheapest to build and the least risky.
Against: still a two-column dashboard, so with real courses it will fill up the same way it does now.

B · Orientation first

The teal moves into the sidebar so the brand lives in one place, and the dead space becomes four numbers an admin opens this page to check.

For: the dashboard finally answers "is anything wrong, does anything need me".
Against: the stat row needs data that is not on this page today, and a dark sidebar is a real visual change to sign off.

C · One column

Sidebar collapses to an icon rail, the right rail goes entirely, and one centred column carries the page. Joining a course moves into the empty state, where it is actually relevant.

For: no stranded rail, and it is already close to the phone layout, which matters given the 640 to 767px gap the mobile audit found.
Against: the biggest departure, and hides the admin navigation behind an icon rail.

In all three: the eight code boxes become one field, the red Admin badge is restyled into the palette, and every empty state names the next action.

The stat numbers in B and the activity lines are invented, as is the January date. Real data would change how that row reads.
